cause: deployment/cart (cart-to-valkey-cart connectivity; root cause not confirmed)
diagnosis: Cart journeys were failing with ReadTimeout and HTTP 500. The cart pod logs showed StackExchange.Redis timeouts ('no connection became available') on every HGET against valkey-cart:6379, while valkey-cart was Running, Ready, and had no restarts. I deleted cart-78b98c8995-ncb4d to reset the Redis connection pool. That did not fix the failure, and the change was rolled back. Journeys are still at 0% OK. Restarting the cart pod was therefore not the fix, and my earlier stated root cause was an unverified hypothesis. The remaining suspects are a network or service path problem between cart and valkey-cart, a Valkey-side connection limit or stall that the logs do not show, or an issue in frontend-proxy routing to cart. A human should check cart-to-valkey-cart connectivity directly and the frontend-proxy /api/cart path, and review Valkey connection metrics.
